（印：上海工部局警务处 23/10 25）

Shanghai Municipal Police.
STRICTLY PRIVATE. In _______
Intelligence Department Station.
21st, October, 1925

REPORT ON Proposals to combat Bolshevism

Made by Temporary Constable COOK. Forwarded by. H. Givens C.D.I.

C.D.I. Givens,
Sir,
I beg to submit the following for your con-
sideration as the facts stated and opinions expressed have been
prompted by the perusal of the monthly reports of your Depart-
ment.
In the first place, it should not be forgotten that the major
ity of the present ruling Communists in Russia are not Russians
but chiefly Letts, Estonians and German Jews from the Baltic Pro-
vinces, therefore it might be expedient to bring the above-mentio
-ned nationalities under observation and those of them who are
or have recently become Soviet citizens should have especial att
-ention. The Bolshevik Secret Police seldom entrusts the actual
work of political agitation to Russians as they are not so clev-
er as the Letts, etc. and consequently there is less risk to be
encountered. They use in preference the dissatisfied elements of
the population in countries where political agitation is deter-
mined upon.
Soviet establishments abroad are extremely careful not to
be involved in actual propaganda on account of the international
complications arising therefrom. In addition, they particularly
dislike and fear being raided, so consequent upon this they leave
the propaganda work to others with the exception perhaps of pay-
out money at times. The Soviet telegraphic agency abroad "Dalta"
used formerly to be the source for supplying political propaganda.
Jewish Clubs and Russian travelling theatrical groups from Rus-
sia are likewise channels along which propaganda is passed.

1925年10月21日

关于打击布尔什维主义提议的报告

由临时巡捕 COOK 提出。经 H. Givens C.D.I. 转呈。

C.D.I. Givens 先生：
谨呈下列内容供阁下考量，所述事实及所陈意见均系拜读贵科月度报告后有感而发。
首先，不应忘记，目前俄国执政的共产党人大多数并非俄国人，而主要是来自波罗的海各省的拉脱维亚人、爱沙尼亚人和德籍犹太人，因此，对上述国籍人员加以监视或许为权宜之计，其中那些已是或最近成为苏维埃公民者应受到特别关注。布尔什维克秘密警察很少将政治煽动的实际工作委托给俄国人，因为他们不如拉脱维亚人等精明，因而面临的风险较小。他们更倾向于利用那些被选定进行政治煽动国家中的不满分子。
海外的苏维埃机构极为谨慎，避免卷入实际的宣传活动，以免由此引发国际纠纷。此外，他们特别厌恶并害怕遭到搜查，因此，除偶尔提供资金外，他们将宣传工作留给他人去做。苏联驻外电讯机构“达尔塔”（Dalta）曾是提供政治宣传的来源。犹太俱乐部以及来自俄国的俄罗斯巡回剧团也是传播宣传的渠道。

21st.October1925 192

REPORT ON Proposals to combat Bolshevism.

Made by temporary constable GOON Forwarded by

The Bolsheviki are moving Heaven and Earth to entice as many important Whites over to their side as is possible with the direct object of picking their brains and profiting their experience for further action against us. Caution therefore should be our pass word with regard to Whites.

KOREANS. The Far Eastern Revolutionary Committee at Habarovsk - the governing body of Eastern Siberia has a section exclusively devoted to Koreans resident in Siberia, who, in accordance with the Seoul Convention of 1884 were recognized as coming under Russian citizenship. The Korean section referred to above publishes a periodical in the Korean language, formerly in at Chita and now at Vladivostock, for purposes of disseminating Bolshevism not so much in Siberia as in Korea and China therefore it might prove advantageous to have the local Korean committees watched.

SOVIET CONSULATE. I suggest that special attention be devoted to all the members of the Soviet Consulate here, their acquaintance cultivated and in general a friendly feeling to be established as there are more flies to be caught with sugar than by vinegar. This was the policy I pursued when in Russia. In addition to this I make the bold proposal to establish immediately, conjointly with the Soviet authorities here, a system for the exchange and cooperation of both parties of matter pertaining to Russian undesirables, unemployed etc. as this might make it incumbent upon the Soviet authorities to shoulder responsibility etc. We stand to gain everything and lose nothing from the introduction of this system. Further I would suggest our receiving newspapers from Chita, Habarovsk and Vladivostock

（批：Recommend that consideration of this proposal be deferred until later. JdS.）
（批：Recommended / JdS.）

1925年10月21日 192

关于打击布尔什维主义提议的报告。

由临时巡捕 GOON 提出 经转呈

布尔什维克正不遗余力地诱使尽可能多的重要白俄分子倒向他们一边，其直接目的是汲取他们的智慧并利用其经验，以便进一步对我们采取行动。因此，对待白俄分子，我们的座右铭应是“谨慎”。

朝鲜人。位于哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk）的远东革命委员会——东西伯利亚的管理机构——设有一个专门针对居住在西伯利亚的朝鲜人的部门，这些人根据1884年《汉城公约》被承认为拥有俄国国籍。上述朝鲜部门出版一种朝鲜文期刊，以前在赤塔（Chita），现在在海参崴（Vladivostock）出版，其目的与其说是在西伯利亚，不如说是在朝鲜和中国传播布尔什维主义，因此，监视当地的朝鲜委员会可能会证明是有益的。

苏联领事馆。我建议对驻此地的苏联领事馆所有成员给予特别关注，与他们建立交情，并总体上营造友好氛围，因为糖比醋能捕捉到更多的苍蝇。这是我在俄国时采取的政策。除此之外，我大胆提议，立即与当地的苏联当局共同建立一个双方就有关俄国不受欢迎人物、失业者等事项进行交换与合作的体系，因为这可能会使苏联当局负有责任等。引入这一体系，我们只有所得，无所损失。此外，我建议我们从赤塔、哈巴罗夫斯克和海参崴接收报纸

（批：建议将此提议的审议推迟至以后。JdS.）
（批：推荐 / JdS.）
